{{Top}}
A '''Vizier''' was a title given to personages employed in service to a ruler – usually of [[Noble/Legends|noble]] lineage. A Vizier acted as a high-ranking [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] or a respected member of the clergy. A Vizier was often left in charge of a region in the event that the chosen ruler was unable to perform their functions. They were most commonly found in [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] run by a [[theocracy]], but this was not true of all governing bodies. Additionally, on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] a vizier served as the equivalent to a [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]].
